name: Legate Corvinus
notes: AC 15 (studded leather). Legate in command of Vindolanda garrison. Commands through intermediaries.
gm_notes: Objective: secure the spear for his Triumph. Goal: keep the party deniable. Agenda: manage the debt to Brutus without anyone knowing. Secret: owes Brutus money -- Brutus owns him. Terrified of Lucius's arrival (watch for him glancing at the staircase twice in two minutes before Lucius arrives). Does not know there is a frumentarius in the assembled unit.
objective: Secure the spear for his Triumph.
goal: Keep the party deniable so blame lands elsewhere.
agenda: Manage the debt to Brutus without anyone discovering it.
secret: Owes Brutus money -- Brutus owns him completely.
